# Designs from other projects

DESIGN.md files published by other design systems, kept as they were
published. They show that a design written for another component library
can replace the built-in one, and the tests read them to prove it.

They are not written to the DESIGN.md token format, so `pnpm design:lint`
leaves this folder alone.
